name: snowmapper-app
description: Capacitor wrapper (iOS + Android) for the Swiss Snow Model web app. The web app itself is generated by ../pipeline/interactive_export.py and is unchanged; this ONE project bundles it as native app assets for both platforms, so iOS and Android always ship the same web build, the same plugins and the same version.

scripts.ios: npm run build:web && cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run build:web && cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.apk: npm run build:web && cap sync android && npm run config:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
